findings.title: Run totals omit earlier loop iterations
findings.description: The report reads only persisted `action_results`. However, loop execution keeps earlier iterations in `StepResult.prior_rounds`, which `StateManager._append_step()` does not serialize. A reproduced three-round loop costing $0.30 reports $0.10. Persist and include every iteration’s usage, with a regression test covering multi-round execution.

findings.title: Split reviews retain only the first part’s usage
findings.description: Usage is stamped separately on each part, but `fold_review_parts()` copies the first part’s metadata without aggregating usage. Reproducing two $0.10 parts produces a $0.10 combined record instead of $0.20. Aggregate all parts’ tokens, turns, duration, and cost before persisting the combined action.

findings.title: Failed split-review parts violate the folding contract
findings.description: Returning `_exception_result()` now lets split-review execution continue with a failed part whose outputs contain no input file. `fold_review_parts()` requires exactly one input per part and raises `TypeError`; the outer handler then discards the captured usage and original failure result. Stop on failure while preserving accumulated spend, or explicitly support failed parts in the folding contract. Add a split-review provider-failure regression test.
